claim: On core 3.03.00 the zxnDMA blitter commands after LOAD and before ENABLE are DF mode, F3 transparent colour, F7 fill value, E3 length.
limit: Only an N-Go board (Issue 2-compatible clone) tested; on port 0x0B the DF modes were inconsistent.

evidence.text: DF m: bit 1 E3 length, bit 2 transparent copy, bit 3 fill; F3 c sets transparent colour (default 0), F7 v fill value (default 0), both before DF; E3 lo hi length (at least 1); no stride mode found.
